page_title: INT 3-2 TOR | Inter v Torino 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.

90+5' Well-positioned Mehdi Taremi (Inter) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
90+2' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
88' Davide Frattesi (Inter) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies miles over the crossbar. Very poor shot.
88' The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
86' 3 - 2 Goal! Yann Sommer gets a hand on the penalty from Nikola Vlasic (Torino), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
86' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

86' The game is interrupted. Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Torino are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
84' Paolo Vanoli is forced to make a change. Duvan Zapata is unable to continue due to injury, Yann Karamoh (Torino) comes on.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is coming onto the pitch as Samuele Ricci cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Bastoni will be replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
81' The injury to Duvan Zapata (Torino) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.

80' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic blocks the shot with his legs.
77' That will be all from Henrikh Mkhitaryan who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
77' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Benjamin Pavard, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
76' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) is flagged for offside.
75' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
75' Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
74' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
73' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is adjudged offside.
68' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Denzel Dumfries (Inter) replacing Matteo Darmian.
68' Substitution. Marcus Thuram did his best and is replaced by Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
65' The referee signals a corner kick to Inter.
65' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
62' Paolo Vanoli is forced to make a change. Valentino Lazaro is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mergim Vojvoda (Torino).
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Gvidas Gineitis will be replaced by Ivan Ilic (Torino).
62' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' 3 - 1 Goal! Marcus Thuram (Inter) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 3:1.

60' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who pulls off a comfortable save!
58' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Karol Linetty (Torino) for his blatant foul.
56' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) unleashed a long-range shot, but it misses narrowly over the bar. It could have been the goal of the month, at least.
55' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
55' Inter take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
55' It looks like Marcus Pedersen (Torino) saw red with that tackle. Matteo Marcenaro won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
53' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' Federico Dimarco (Inter) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
51' The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' Federico Dimarco (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
50' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
49' Duvan Zapata (Torino) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
48' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
46' Half-time substitution. Simone Inzaghi decided to make a change. Yann Bisseck (Inter) is replaced by Benjamin Pavard.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Marcus Thuram (Inter) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
45+2' Inter win a corner.
45+2' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45+2' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Now Inter have a corner.
41' What a wasted opportunity by Federico Dimarco (Inter)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a decent save to thwart him.
39' Federico Dimarco (Inter) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.

37' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Duvan Zapata (Torino). Gvidas Gineitis plays a fantastic through ball and finds Duvan Zapata (Torino), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the right side of the goal. It's now 2:1.
36' Yann Bisseck (Inter) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' 2 - 0 Goal! Francesco Acerbi swings the ball deep into the box and finds Marcus Thuram (Inter) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the right side of the goal. 2:0.
35' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
33' That's the end of the game for Che Adams, who is replaced by Adam Masina (Torino).
31' The ball unexpectedly rebounds out to Matteo Darmian (Inter) on the edge of the box, but his attempt is lame and ends up well wide of the right post.
31' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared.
31' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Federico Dimarco (Inter), but the defence gets it clear.
30' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
29' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Marcus Thuram (Inter) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
28' Inter take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
28' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find Davide Frattesi, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

25' 1 - 0 Federico Dimarco displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Marcus Thuram (Inter) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it in off the left post – 1:0.
24' The corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is cleared away by the defence.
24' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
22' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
20' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Guillermo Maripan (Torino) has to leave the pitch!
20' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Guillermo Maripan (Torino)! Let's see what he decides.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Guillermo Maripan (Torino) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' Flag goes up against Davide Frattesi (Inter) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

14' Samuele Ricci (Torino) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Yann Sommer!
14' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
12' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic steps in and intercepts a long pass from Federico Dimarco (Inter).
11' Matteo Marcenaro has a clear sight and sees a foul from Duvan Zapata (Torino). Inter have a free kick.
10' Marcus Thuram (Inter) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
7' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
7' Federico Dimarco (Inter) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.

5' A cross by Matteo Darmian (Inter) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Torino will take the kick-off.
Matteo Marcenaro was nominated as the referee for this game.
